items.titleZh: Grab the Asus Prime Radeon RX 9070 OC for $629.99 — save $120 on this 16GB gaming GPU for reliable 1440p and 4K gaming
items.descriptionZh:
当前显卡市场受DRAM和NAND存储芯片价格持续上涨影响，消费者几乎很难找到合适的显卡优惠。在此背景下，华硕Prime AMD Radeon RX 9070 OC版显卡在亚马逊上的促销活动显得尤为难得——其售价从常规的750美元降至629.99美元，优惠幅度达16%（约120美元）。这一价格定位使其成为中端游戏玩家值得关注的选项。

从核心技术来看，RX 9070基于AMD最新的RDNA 4架构，整合了新一代光线追踪加速器和AI加速器，旨在提升光追渲染效率和AI辅助功能（如帧生成、画质增强）的算力支持。该显卡配备56个计算单元、16GB GDDR6显存，显存位宽为256位，整卡板载功耗(Board Power)为220W。得益于RDNA 4架构在能效比和先进制程上的优化，该卡能够为高刷新率1440p游戏提供稳定输出，并具备应对4K分辨率的基础性能。

华硕Prime OC版在公版基础上进行了强化设计：采用2.5插槽厚度和312mm长度，适合主流中塔机箱；内置双BIOS切换，用户可在“性能模式”与“静音模式”间自由选择，平衡散热噪音与性能表现。散热系统方面，三颗Axial-Tech轴流风扇采用了加长叶片设计，以增强风压和气流覆盖率；同时使用相变GPU导热垫替代传统硅脂，在温度波动时仍能保持稳定的热传导效率，优化热量排出。此外，该卡出厂即进行了超频，Boost频率最高可达2610 MHz，游戏时钟频率为2140 MHz，相比公版拥有更高的性能余量。

根据实际性能测试，RX 9070的总体表现与NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti Super相当。在16款主流游戏的光栅化渲染几何平均测试中，该卡在1440p超高画质下平均帧率达到86.6 FPS，在4K超高画质下平均帧率为52.2 FPS。这意味着它在1440p下应对电竞或3A大作高刷需求绰绰有余，即使在4K分辨率下也能保持流畅的60帧入门体验，若结合FSR等超分辨率技术，实际游戏表现更为出色。

综合来看，这款华硕Prime AMD Radeon RX 9070 OC版显卡非常适合计划升级1440p游戏主机的用户。尤其当前629.99美元的促销价相对市场行情具有较强吸引力。不过，此类优惠属于限时促销，库存可能随时告罄，建议有购买计划的消费者尽早下单，以免错过窗口期。

items.title: Nvidia reportedly warns biggest customers of 15% price hikes on AI servers — memory costs continue to soar
items.description: The increases will take effect on Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems shipping early next year.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia has told some of its largest customers that the prices of servers containing its AI chips will rise by more than 15% in many cases, Bloomberg reported on Saturday. The increases will take effect on Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems shipping early next year, according to people familiar with the matter, who commented on communications that have not yet been made public. The size of each increase will depend on the chip generation and the memory configuration involved. Companies that build servers under contract for large data center operators, including Microsoft, Google, and Oracle, have recently notified their customers of the forthcoming increases, the people told Bloomberg.This is another example of the so-called "RAMageddon" that's gripping the DRAM market, with contract prices having risen at record rates this year. Analysts projected that conventional DRAM contract prices would climb 58% to 63% quarter-over-quarter in Q2 2026, following a Q1 surge of 90% to 95%, as suppliers reallocated capacity toward HBM and server products. SK hynix said in October last year that it had already sold out its entire 2026 memory production capacity, and Samsung and SK hynix raised 2026 HBM3E supply prices by close to 20% before the year began. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)AI systems carry enormous memory loadouts, with Nvidia's Rubin GPU shipping with up to 288GB of HBM4 per package, and the NVL72 rack-scale system combines 72 of those GPUs, putting more than 20TB of HBM in a single rack before accounting for the LPDDR attached to its Vera CPUs. With HBM production consuming roughly four times the wafer area of equivalent conventional DRAM, memory has become one of the largest line items in an AI server's bill of materials, and it's continuing to rise at a stratospheric pace.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Ironically, the supply crunch that's now inflating Nvidia's systems is the same one its demand helped to create. The three major memory makers spent this and last year shifting advanced nodes and new capacity toward HBM and high-capacity server DRAM, starving commodity markets in the process. Consumer DDR5 pricing has more than doubled since late 2025 as a result, with a mainstream 32GB DDR5-6000 kit selling for around $392 in August against $110 to $140 a year earlier, according to our RAM price tracker.Nvidia has already passed rising costs through to consumers, raising prices on GeForce graphics cards earlier this month. The Bloomberg report indicates the same unrelenting pressure has now reached the top of the Nvidia stack, where hyperscalers as well as PC builders will be absorbing the increase. A 15% rise on rack-scale systems that sell for several million dollars each adds hundreds of thousands of dollars per rack across deployments that run to thousands of racks. You may like Nvidia reportedly testing lower memory configs of Rubin Ultra as memory shortage bites back The rise of local agentic computing faces a brutal reality: rising DRAM prices AI memory shortage is now increasing the price of cars Nvidia runs a gross margin of roughly 75% non-GAAP, among the highest in the semiconductor industry, and the reported hikes indicate the company intends to pass memory cost inflation on to customers rather than absorb it, which it can more than afford to do. Meanwhile, supply of its accelerators from TSMC still can't meet demand, which limits buyers' immediate leverage.Whether the increases push hyperscalers further toward AMD's accelerators or their own custom silicon will depend on how quickly those alternatives can absorb displaced demand, and all of them draw HBM from the same three constrained suppliers.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.

items.titleZh: Nvidia reportedly warns biggest customers of 15% price hikes on AI servers — memory costs continue to soar
items.descriptionZh:
英伟达向部分最大客户发出通知：其AI服务器价格将在多数情况下上涨超过15%，这一涨幅涉及明年年初交付的Grace Blackwell和Vera Rubin系统，具体幅度取决于芯片代次及内存配置。据知情人士透露，为微软、谷歌、甲骨文等大型数据中心运营商代工服务器的合约制造商，近期已陆续向客户通报了即将到来的涨价。这是当前DRAM市场所谓“RAMageddon”（内存大涨价）现象的又一体现——今年内存合约价格以创纪录速度飙升。

从根源看，这轮供应危机的成因正是AI需求激增本身。三大内存制造商在过去两年间将先进制程产能和新产线大幅转向HBM（高带宽内存）与高容量服务器DRAM，导致传统内存市场供应枯竭。分析师预测，2026年第二季度常规DRAM合约价将环比再涨58%至63%，而一季度已经历了90%至95%的暴涨。SK海力士早在2025年10月就宣布2026年内存产能全部售罄，三星与SK海力士更是在2026年到来前便将HBM3E供应价格上调近20%。

AI系统的内存负载之巨是这股涨价潮的直接推手。英伟达Rubin GPU单封装集成最高288GB HBM4，而NVL72机架级系统包含72颗该GPU，单个机架内的HBM总量超过20TB，此外还要加上Vera CPU所搭载的LPDDR内存。由于HBM生产所消耗的晶圆面积约为同容量传统DRAM的四倍，内存已成为AI服务器物料清单中最大的单项成本之一，且仍在以惊人速度攀升。

消费级市场同样受到波及。自2025年末以来，DDR5内存价格已翻倍有余——主流32GB DDR5-6000套件在2026年8月售价约392美元，而一年前仅需110至140美元。英伟达此前已通过上调GeForce显卡价格向消费者转嫁成本，如今压力已传导至其产品线顶端。对于售价数百万美元一台的机架级系统，15%的涨幅意味着每个机架增加数十万美元成本，而当部署规模达到数千个机架时，这笔额外开支将极为庞大。

值得关注的是，英伟达非GAAP毛利率高达约75%，处于半导体行业最顶尖水平，此次涨价表明公司选择将内存成本通胀完全转嫁给客户而非自行消化——尽管它完全有能力承担。与此同时，台积电的加速器产能仍供不应求，这大大限制了采购方的议价空间。涨价是否会推动超大规模云厂商进一步转向AMD加速器或自研芯片，将取决于这些替代方案能否在短期内承接转移的需求，但一个现实制约是：所有厂商的HBM都仰仗三星、SK海力士和美光这三家同样受限的供应商。

items.title: Nvidia’s GB300-powered DGX Station desktop tower listed for nearly $100,000 online — Enterprise AI powerhouse now available to buy for mere mortals with lots of cash
items.description: Nvidia's most powerful desktop offering, the GB300 DGX Station, is available to buy starting from just $94,930 and you can spec it up to $108,350. It offers 748GB of unified memory shared across the 72-core Grace CPU and Blackwell Ultra GPU, and it can be yours in a pretty standard-looking desktop chassis today.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia officially launched the latest DGX Station desktop at Computex 2026 earlier this year, but the announcement was not accompanied by an explicit price tag. The expectation of an MSRP withers away when it comes to enterprise-grade hardware anyway, but still, early chatter had pointed toward a $100,000 ballpark figure. That number has just been confirmed, as a DGX Station from Exxact was found listed for $94,930 on its website, featuring the all-powerful GB300 Superchip, ready to customize and buy.I repeatedly asked Nvidia at Computex how much the DGX Station desktop tower PC was going to be. The rep kept dodging the question. Welp. It's $100,000 pic.twitter.com/WRxL5Iq7k9August 22, 2026The desktop tower in question is the Valence VWS-158270643 that was originally unveiled a few months ago and was part of the lineup shared by other OEMs such as Dell and HP. Since this hardware is not meant for regular consumers — those who can afford it can pay really any price for it — Nvidia's partners don't make its cost outright public information. Instead, you can ask for quotes or inquire about a proper deployment to get the number. That's why the Exxact listing is newsworthy.The Valence VWS-158270643 starts at $94,930, and that gets you one GB300 enclosed in a standard full-sized tower. The main draw of the GB300 is the Blackwell Ultra GPU that comes with 252GB of HBM3e memory. It talks to a 72-core Arm-based Grace CPU through a 900 GB/s NVLink-C2C interconnect that shares a further 496GB of LPDDR5x RAM with the GPU.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Combined, you get a massive 748GB pool of unified memory that allows you to fine-tune and deploy AI models locally instead of worrying about token costs or any cloud vulnerabilities. For large enterprises that need to quickly iterate on the go and want maximum security, a DGX Station is considered a worthwhile investment even at $100,000, especially if the smaller DGX Spark isn't enough for your workloads. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Exxact) (Image credit: Exxact) (Image credit: Exxact) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original The Valence VWS-158270643 in specific can be configured with different GPUs for video output (since the GB300 doesn't have one) and you get a few SSD options to choose from based on your training data needs. There are three "optimized configs" that go up to $96,316. The top-tier manual configuration costs $108,350 with an RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell (that has its own 96GB of VRAM) and 2x extra 2TB PCIe 5.0 SSDs. Though it comes with Linux-based DGX OS out of the box instead of Windows. Both the Grace CPU and the Blackwell Ultra GPU are liquid-cooled with a massive direct-to-chip (D2C) coldplate, and there are three fans up top for optimal airflow.Front panel I/O is nonexistent, but there are 2x QSFP112 ports at the back driven by the integrated ConnectX-SuperNIC for 800 Gbps/s interconnect between two DGX Station towers. There's also 1x 10 Gbps RJ45 port, a dedicated 1Gbps RJ45 management port, 1x mini-DisplayPort for local BMC management (not display out), 1x USB Micro-B for direct serial access to said BMC, 4x standard USB Type-A, and a 3.5mm headphone jack.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsExxact did not disclose the exact materials of the tower, but we can infer from the pictures that it's made out of steel, and the design is rather sleek. For $100,000, you also get a 3-year warranty so you can rest assured your parts are insured against a potential popping of a bubble. You can order up to ten of these at the same time, but there's no standard checkout page; you still have to provide your details in order to be contacted back for a purchase. items.titleZh: Nvidia’s GB300-powered DGX Station desktop tower listed for nearly $100,000 online — Enterprise AI powerhouse now available to buy for mere mortals with lots of cash
items.descriptionZh:
Nvidia在今年早些时候的Computex 2026上正式发布了最新的DGX Station台式工作站，但当时并未公布具体售价。对于企业级硬件而言，官方建议零售价本就形同虚设，不过业内早前猜测其价格将在10万美元左右。如今这一数字得到证实——系统集成商Exxact网站上已列出该产品，标价为94,930美元，搭载被称为“全能王”的GB300超级芯片，支持定制化配置。

这款型号为Valence VWS-158270643的塔式工作站几个月前已随戴尔、惠普等OEM厂商的产品线一同亮相。由于该硬件并非面向普通消费者，而是针对可承受任意价格的企业客户，Nvidia合作伙伴通常不直接公开成本，需要用户询价或洽谈部署方案，因此Exxact的公开标价颇具新闻价值。

Valence VWS-158270643起价94,930美元，包含一颗GB300超级芯片。其核心亮点是Blackwell Ultra GPU，配备252GB HBM3e高带宽显存，通过900GB/s的NVLink-C2C互联与一颗72核Arm架构Grace CPU通信，两者共享额外496GB LPDDR5x内存。三者合计构成高达748GB的统一内存池，用户可以在本地微调和部署AI模型，无需担忧云端token费用或安全漏洞。对于需要快速迭代并追求极致安全的大型企业，即使10万美元的价格，DGX Station仍被视为值得的投资，尤其是当较小的DGX Spark无法满足工作负载时。

Exxact型号支持配置不同GPU用于视频输出（因GB300本身无显示输出），并提供多种SSD选择以匹配训练数据需求。三种“优化配置”最高售价96,316美元，而顶级手动配置达到108,350美元，包含一块自带96GB VRAM的RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell显卡和两块额外的2TB PCIe 5.0 SSD。

该工作站配备1600W 80+钛金电源，足以覆盖独立显示GPU，可与普通PC一样插入标准插座使用。系统默认运行基于Linux的DGX OS而非Windows。Grace CPU与Blackwell Ultra GPU均采用大规模直接芯片（D2C）冷板液冷散热，顶部配有三个风扇保证气流。机箱前部无I/O接口，后部提供2个QSFP112端口，由集成ConnectX-SuperNIC驱动，支持两台DGX Station之间以800Gbps速率互联；另有1个10GbE RJ45网口、专用1Gbps管理网口、用于本地BMC管理的mini-DisplayPort、USB Micro-B串口、4个标准USB Type-A接口及3.5mm耳机插孔。

Exxact未透露机箱具体材质，但从图片可推断为钢材，设计颇为简洁。10万美元的价格附带3年质保，用户可放心部件安全。单次最多可订购十台，但无标准结算页面，仍需提交联系资料等待回访确认购买。

items.title: Lucky shopper finds RTX 5080 for just $702 at Walmart — saves almost $800 compared to current retail prices
items.description: Walmart’s clearance aisle delivers another remarkable GPU bargain, with a shopper finding a PNY RTX 5080 for nearly half its current retail price.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Shopping for PC parts continues to be a nightmare, with skyrocketing RAM, SSD, and GPU prices paired with unpredictable availability. However, a lucky shopper managed to score a flagship GPU for far less than its original launch price. According to Reddit user u/sparkyscotty55, their local Walmart store was selling a PNY-branded Nvidia RTX 5080 for just $702.56, down from its listed selling price of $1,249. Not only does this deal result in a discount of $546.44, but its final price is also much lower than Nvidia’s suggested $999 retail price for the RTX 5080.A quick price check reveals that this particular PNY RTX 5080 OC graphics card is currently listed at over $1,500 on Amazon, Newegg, and Best Buy. This makes the Walmart clearance price even more impressive, with the shopper essentially paying less than half of what the GPU currently costs at major retailers. The shopper also confirmed that they inspected the box to verify that the GPU inside was indeed the correct model and appeared to be in good condition.Walmart deal how did I do from r/pcmasterraceThe PNY GeForce RTX 5080 OC is a factory-overclocked version of Nvidia's reference RTX 5080 that targets 4K gaming and content-creation workloads. The RTX 5080 packs 10,752 CUDA cores, 16GB of GDDR7 memory on a 256-bit bus, and up to 960 GB/s of memory bandwidth. Its fifth-generation Tensor cores and fourth-generation RT cores enable features such as AI acceleration, hardware-accelerated ray tracing, and Nvidia's DLSS 4 technology, including Multi Frame Generation. The GPU is listed to push the boost clock to 2.73 GHz, up from Nvidia's reference 2.62 GHz, while retaining the 360W power rating. It also uses a substantial cooling system with three 100mm silent fans and a dense heatsink, along with a triple-slot design.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Walmart's clearance aisles have produced rare but similar GPU bargains in the past. For instance, back in February another shopper managed to grab the same RTX 5080 model at just $562.49. During that period, it was one of the few RTX 5080 models sold at Nvidia’s suggested MSRP of $999, thus resulting in an impressive discount of $430 for the lucky customer. Another Walmart clearance find involved an RTX 5060 Ti, with a customer picking up an MSI RTX 5060 Ti Ventus 2X 8GB at just $80. Since the card had launched with an MSRP of $379, the shopper managed to end up saving nearly $300. The deal was particularly interesting as the buyer was reportedly upgrading from a much older GTX 1060, resulting in a massive generational leap at a negligible price.While such deals occasionally result in an incredible bargain, there is always an element of risk, especially when it involves expensive PC hardware. Such items could be customer returns with opened boxes, or items that have been marked down because of damaged packaging or missing accessories. There are also some cases where heavily discounted PC components are returned units that are either damaged, swapped, or do not include the hardware originally sold with it, which makes checking the contents before completing the purchase particularly important. items.titleZh: 幸运购物者在沃尔玛仅花702美元买到RTX 5080，比当前零售价节省近800美元
items.descriptionZh:
近期PC硬件市场价格持续走高，内存、固态硬盘和显卡价格飙升且供货不稳定，令DIY玩家叫苦不迭。然而，一位幸运的购物者却在沃尔玛的清仓货架上淘到了一块旗舰级显卡，价格远低于首发价。据Reddit用户u/sparkyscotty55发帖称，他在当地沃尔玛商店以702.56美元的价格购得一块PNY品牌的Nvidia RTX 5080显卡，而该卡在店内的标价原本为1,249美元。此次折扣高达546.44美元，最终成交价甚至比Nvidia官方建议零售价999美元还低近300美元。

经比价后发现，这款PNY RTX 5080 OC显卡目前在亚马逊、Newegg和百思买上的售价均超过1,500美元，这意味着这位购物者实际支付的价格还不到大型零售商现价的一半。该买家还表示，他当场检查了外包装，确认盒内显卡确为对应型号，且外观状态良好。

这款PNY GeForce RTX 5080 OC是Nvidia RTX 5080参考版的出厂超频型号，定位面向4K游戏和内容创作场景。核心规格方面，它拥有10,752个CUDA核心，配备16GB GDDR7显存，位宽256-bit，显存带宽最高可达960 GB/s。其第五代Tensor Core和第四代RT Core支持AI加速、硬件光追以及Nvidia DLSS 4技术，包括多帧生成（Multi Frame Generation）功能。该卡将加速频率从Nvidia参考版的2.62 GHz提升至2.73 GHz，功耗维持360W不变。散热设计上，该卡采用三槽厚度，配备三把100mm静音风扇和密集型散热鳍片，确保高负载下的温度控制。

类似的沃尔玛清仓显卡低价并非首次出现。今年2月，也曾有另一位买家以仅562.49美元的价格买到同款RTX 5080，当时这款卡在Nvidia建议零售价999美元的基础上已属稀缺，最终相当于额外省下约430美元。另一起案例中，有顾客在沃尔玛以80美元购入一块微星RTX 5060 Ti Ventus 2X 8GB，而这款卡首发建议零售价为379美元，相当于节省近300美元。更特别的是，这位买家据称是从老旧的GTX 1060升级而来，几乎以可忽略的成本实现了跨越数代的大幅性能跃升。

不过，这类清仓特价也伴随着一定风险，尤其是对于高价值PC硬件而言。打折商品可能是被退货的开封产品，也可能因包装破损或附件缺失而降价。更有甚者，部分大幅降价的部件可能是被调包、损坏或不包含原始配件的退货件。因此，在付款前仔细检查包装和内部硬件是否完好、确认型号与附件正确，显得尤为重要。这类稀有交易虽然偶尔能带来惊人性价比，但消费者仍需保持警惕，避免因贪图便宜而踩坑。

items.title: Officials nationwide face death threats and gunfire over AI data center projects — More than 500 towns restrict builds as councils shutter public comment
items.description: Recent data published in the Soufan Center's July IntelBrief found hundreds of posts with threat language between July 2025 and July 2026, and a volume surge beginning in April.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Officials in Marshall, Michigan, did what data center opponents across the country have been demanding: on August 3, its city council passed a one-year moratorium on new builds. Ten days later, police told council members they were the subject of a credible death threat tied to the project. The same week, the 300-person town of Salix, Iowa, postponed its own moratorium vote after Facebook posts put its government "in the crosshairs," and in Box Elder County, Utah, a commissioner who approved a project told KSL he has police stationed outside his house. Then, on August 21, NBC News reported that city leaders nationwide are now receiving death threats over data centers, regardless of which way officials vote.Marshall Mayor Scott Wolfersberger told local news station WWMT that the city's police department contacted him on August 12 about the threat and that the investigation is ongoing. Councilor James Hackworth wrote in a social media post that members had received "a legitimate death threat" and that disagreement, protest, and voting the council out are all part of democracy. It's unclear whether the sender supports or opposes data centers, and no suspect has been identified to date.Meanwhile, Salix Mayor Kevin Nelson has said that the Woodbury County Sheriff's Office is investigating posts that called for "various death and terroristic type things" against the entire city government. Nelson said threats first came in May, after the town annexed 900 acres of farmland in April for a site Google is evaluating.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Woodbury County is separately challenging the annexation in court. The council met a week late on August 20 and voted 3-2 against the moratorium, with Nelson calling officers into the room as members of the public and councilman Gene Monk objected. "We ask for a cool-down period for a year to research, then we can make an educated decision. We can let the people vote for it after that — do something different," Monk said. "It's too big of a decision for us five people [council members]."Over in Box Elder County, Utah, Commissioner Lee Perry has said that he and fellow Commissioners Boyd Bingham and Tyler Vincent had received threats after voting through two resolutions for the Stratos project area, with an audience of roughly 500 chanting "shame" at the meeting. You may like Kansas town silences public comment on gigawatt AI data center after receiving death threats, moves to virtual meetings AI data center bans surge past 500 nationwide as local US politicians begin quickly blocking new developments 142 AI data center protests staged in 42 states as public opposition increases Previous incidents show these are more than idle threats. In April, Indianapolis councilman Ron Gibson had 13 rounds fired into his home after backing a rezoning, and Saline Township, Michigan, treasurer Jennifer Zink resigned in May citing threats over the 1.4GW Oracle and OpenAI campus that triggered moratoriums in at least 19 Michigan municipalities. Emporia, Kansas, moved its August 5 and August 19 commission meetings online and dropped public comment after its leaders were threatened.Recent data published in the Soufan Center's July IntelBrief, which is based on a year of scraping X and Reddit, found hundreds of posts with threat language between July 2025 and July 2026, and a volume surge beginning in April that hasn't receded. Most violent threats in its dataset are targeted towards infrastructure rather than people, with posts naming council members and planning commissions a small minority. Many use memes, emojis, and misspellings to dodge moderation.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThe center also found that each new incident now draws far more secondary amplification than it did earlier in the year. Emporia's mayor said the threats to his commission didn't appear to come from locals, and Salix, Emporia, and Marshall have all now canceled, moved, or restricted public meetings because of them, at a point when more than 500 local restrictions on data centers are in place nationwide. items.titleZh: Officials nationwide face death threats and gunfire over AI data center projects — More than 500 towns restrict builds as councils shutter public comment
items.descriptionZh:
过去一年间，美国各地围绕AI数据中心建设的冲突持续升级，如今已从激烈的公共辩论演变为针对地方官员的直接人身威胁。密歇根州马歇尔市成为最新案例：8月3日，市议会顺应全国反对者的呼声，通过了一项为期一年的新建项目暂停令；仅十天后，警方告知议员们，他们因该决定收到了可信的死亡威胁。同样在这一周，爱荷华州仅有300人口的Salix镇在Facebook上出现针对整个市政府的“各类死亡和恐怖主义言论”后，被迫推迟了原定的暂停令投票；犹他州Box Elder县一位批准项目的专员透露，已有警察驻扎在他家门外。8月21日，NBC新闻报道称，全美各地的城市领导人如今无论投票倾向如何，都在因数据中心问题收到死亡威胁。

马歇尔市长Scott Wolfersberger向当地媒体证实，警方于8月12日联系了他，调查仍在进行中。市议员James Hackworth在社交媒体上表示，议员们收到了“合法的死亡威胁”，同时强调分歧、抗议和投票罢免官员都属于民主的组成部分。目前尚不清楚威胁发送者是支持还是反对数据中心项目，也无人被捕。Salix市长Kevin Nelson称，伍德伯里县警长办公室正在调查相关帖子——这些威胁最早出现在5月，正值该镇4月吞并900英亩农田以配合谷歌评估选址之后。该县已另行在法庭上对吞并提出异议。Salix议会推迟一周后于8月20日开会，以3比2否决了暂停令；期间市长将警察召入会场，因为公众和一名市议员Gene Monk表示强烈反对。Monk在讨论中说：“我们要求有一年的冷静期来做研究，然后才能做出明智的决定。之后可以让人民投票——换一种做法。这对我们五个人（议员）来说，决定太重大了。”

在犹他州Box Elder县，专员Lee Perry透露，他和同事Boyd Bingham、Tyler Vincent在约500名观众齐声高喊“可耻”的会议上投票通过Stratos项目区的两项决议后，都收到了威胁。这些并非孤立事件，此前已有暴力先例：4月，印第安纳波利斯市议员Ron Gibson在支持一项重新分区后，家中被人射入13发子弹；密歇根州Saline Township财务主管Jennifer Zink在5月因1.4GW的Oracle与OpenAI园区项目遭受威胁而辞职，该项目曾导致至少19个密歇根州城镇出台暂停令。堪萨斯州Emporia市在领导人受威胁后，将8月5日和19日的委员会会议改为线上，并取消了公众评论环节。

Soufan中心7月发布的IntelBrief报告基于对X和Reddit平台为期一年的数据抓取，发现2025年7月至2026年7月间有数百条包含威胁性语言的帖子，且从4月开始数量激增，至今未见回落。数据显示，大多数暴力威胁指向基础设施而非具体个人，点名议员和规划委员会的帖子只占少数。许多帖子使用表情包、表情符号和故意拼写错误来规避平台审核。该中心还发现，每一起新事件现在引发的次级放大效应远高于今年早些时候。Emporia市长表示，针对委员会的威胁似乎并非来自当地居民。目前，Salix、Emporia和马歇尔都已因威胁取消、转移或限制了公共会议——而此时全美已有超过500项针对数据中心的本地限制措施生效。这场由AI算力需求驱动的建设热潮，正在把原本属于土地规划和能源分配的地方决策，推向安全与民主治理层面的严峻考验。

history.descriptionZh:
当前显卡市场受DRAM和NAND存储芯片价格持续上涨影响，消费者几乎很难找到合适的显卡优惠。在此背景下，华硕Prime AMD Radeon RX 9070 OC版显卡在亚马逊上的促销活动显得尤为难得——其售价从常规的750美元降至629.99美元，优惠幅度达16%（约120美元）。这一价格定位使其成为中端游戏玩家值得关注的选项。

从核心技术来看，RX 9070基于AMD最新的RDNA 4架构，整合了新一代光线追踪加速器和AI加速器，旨在提升光追渲染效率和AI辅助功能（如帧生成、画质增强）的算力支持。该显卡配备56个计算单元、16GB GDDR6显存，显存位宽为256位，整卡板载功耗(Board Power)为220W。得益于RDNA 4架构在能效比和先进制程上的优化，该卡能够为高刷新率1440p游戏提供稳定输出，并具备应对4K分辨率的基础性能。

华硕Prime OC版在公版基础上进行了强化设计：采用2.5插槽厚度和312mm长度，适合主流中塔机箱；内置双BIOS切换，用户可在“性能模式”与“静音模式”间自由选择，平衡散热噪音与性能表现。散热系统方面，三颗Axial-Tech轴流风扇采用了加长叶片设计，以增强风压和气流覆盖率；同时使用相变GPU导热垫替代传统硅脂，在温度波动时仍能保持稳定的热传导效率，优化热量排出。此外，该卡出厂即进行了超频，Boost频率最高可达2610 MHz，游戏时钟频率为2140 MHz，相比公版拥有更高的性能余量。

根据实际性能测试，RX 9070的总体表现与NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti Super相当。在16款主流游戏的光栅化渲染几何平均测试中，该卡在1440p超高画质下平均帧率达到86.6 FPS，在4K超高画质下平均帧率为52.2 FPS。这意味着它在1440p下应对电竞或3A大作高刷需求绰绰有余，即使在4K分辨率下也能保持流畅的60帧入门体验，若结合FSR等超分辨率技术，实际游戏表现更为出色。

综合来看，这款华硕Prime AMD Radeon RX 9070 OC版显卡非常适合计划升级1440p游戏主机的用户。尤其当前629.99美元的促销价相对市场行情具有较强吸引力。不过，此类优惠属于限时促销，库存可能随时告罄，建议有购买计划的消费者尽早下单，以免错过窗口期。

history.title: Nvidia reportedly warns biggest customers of 15% price hikes on AI servers — memory costs continue to soar
history.description: The increases will take effect on Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems shipping early next year.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia has told some of its largest customers that the prices of servers containing its AI chips will rise by more than 15% in many cases, Bloomberg reported on Saturday. The increases will take effect on Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems shipping early next year, according to people familiar with the matter, who commented on communications that have not yet been made public. The size of each increase will depend on the chip generation and the memory configuration involved. Companies that build servers under contract for large data center operators, including Microsoft, Google, and Oracle, have recently notified their customers of the forthcoming increases, the people told Bloomberg.This is another example of the so-called "RAMageddon" that's gripping the DRAM market, with contract prices having risen at record rates this year. Analysts projected that conventional DRAM contract prices would climb 58% to 63% quarter-over-quarter in Q2 2026, following a Q1 surge of 90% to 95%, as suppliers reallocated capacity toward HBM and server products. SK hynix said in October last year that it had already sold out its entire 2026 memory production capacity, and Samsung and SK hynix raised 2026 HBM3E supply prices by close to 20% before the year began. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)AI systems carry enormous memory loadouts, with Nvidia's Rubin GPU shipping with up to 288GB of HBM4 per package, and the NVL72 rack-scale system combines 72 of those GPUs, putting more than 20TB of HBM in a single rack before accounting for the LPDDR attached to its Vera CPUs. With HBM production consuming roughly four times the wafer area of equivalent conventional DRAM, memory has become one of the largest line items in an AI server's bill of materials, and it's continuing to rise at a stratospheric pace.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Ironically, the supply crunch that's now inflating Nvidia's systems is the same one its demand helped to create. The three major memory makers spent this and last year shifting advanced nodes and new capacity toward HBM and high-capacity server DRAM, starving commodity markets in the process. Consumer DDR5 pricing has more than doubled since late 2025 as a result, with a mainstream 32GB DDR5-6000 kit selling for around $392 in August against $110 to $140 a year earlier, according to our RAM price tracker.Nvidia has already passed rising costs through to consumers, raising prices on GeForce graphics cards earlier this month. The Bloomberg report indicates the same unrelenting pressure has now reached the top of the Nvidia stack, where hyperscalers as well as PC builders will be absorbing the increase. A 15% rise on rack-scale systems that sell for several million dollars each adds hundreds of thousands of dollars per rack across deployments that run to thousands of racks. You may like Nvidia reportedly testing lower memory configs of Rubin Ultra as memory shortage bites back The rise of local agentic computing faces a brutal reality: rising DRAM prices AI memory shortage is now increasing the price of cars Nvidia runs a gross margin of roughly 75% non-GAAP, among the highest in the semiconductor industry, and the reported hikes indicate the company intends to pass memory cost inflation on to customers rather than absorb it, which it can more than afford to do. Meanwhile, supply of its accelerators from TSMC still can't meet demand, which limits buyers' immediate leverage.Whether the increases push hyperscalers further toward AMD's accelerators or their own custom silicon will depend on how quickly those alternatives can absorb displaced demand, and all of them draw HBM from the same three constrained suppliers.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.

history.titleZh: Nvidia reportedly warns biggest customers of 15% price hikes on AI servers — memory costs continue to soar
history.descriptionZh:
英伟达向部分最大客户发出通知：其AI服务器价格将在多数情况下上涨超过15%，这一涨幅涉及明年年初交付的Grace Blackwell和Vera Rubin系统，具体幅度取决于芯片代次及内存配置。据知情人士透露，为微软、谷歌、甲骨文等大型数据中心运营商代工服务器的合约制造商，近期已陆续向客户通报了即将到来的涨价。这是当前DRAM市场所谓“RAMageddon”（内存大涨价）现象的又一体现——今年内存合约价格以创纪录速度飙升。

从根源看，这轮供应危机的成因正是AI需求激增本身。三大内存制造商在过去两年间将先进制程产能和新产线大幅转向HBM（高带宽内存）与高容量服务器DRAM，导致传统内存市场供应枯竭。分析师预测，2026年第二季度常规DRAM合约价将环比再涨58%至63%，而一季度已经历了90%至95%的暴涨。SK海力士早在2025年10月就宣布2026年内存产能全部售罄，三星与SK海力士更是在2026年到来前便将HBM3E供应价格上调近20%。

AI系统的内存负载之巨是这股涨价潮的直接推手。英伟达Rubin GPU单封装集成最高288GB HBM4，而NVL72机架级系统包含72颗该GPU，单个机架内的HBM总量超过20TB，此外还要加上Vera CPU所搭载的LPDDR内存。由于HBM生产所消耗的晶圆面积约为同容量传统DRAM的四倍，内存已成为AI服务器物料清单中最大的单项成本之一，且仍在以惊人速度攀升。

消费级市场同样受到波及。自2025年末以来，DDR5内存价格已翻倍有余——主流32GB DDR5-6000套件在2026年8月售价约392美元，而一年前仅需110至140美元。英伟达此前已通过上调GeForce显卡价格向消费者转嫁成本，如今压力已传导至其产品线顶端。对于售价数百万美元一台的机架级系统，15%的涨幅意味着每个机架增加数十万美元成本，而当部署规模达到数千个机架时，这笔额外开支将极为庞大。

值得关注的是，英伟达非GAAP毛利率高达约75%，处于半导体行业最顶尖水平，此次涨价表明公司选择将内存成本通胀完全转嫁给客户而非自行消化——尽管它完全有能力承担。与此同时，台积电的加速器产能仍供不应求，这大大限制了采购方的议价空间。涨价是否会推动超大规模云厂商进一步转向AMD加速器或自研芯片，将取决于这些替代方案能否在短期内承接转移的需求，但一个现实制约是：所有厂商的HBM都仰仗三星、SK海力士和美光这三家同样受限的供应商。

history.title: Nvidia’s GB300-powered DGX Station desktop tower listed for nearly $100,000 online — Enterprise AI powerhouse now available to buy for mere mortals with lots of cash
history.description: Nvidia's most powerful desktop offering, the GB300 DGX Station, is available to buy starting from just $94,930 and you can spec it up to $108,350. It offers 748GB of unified memory shared across the 72-core Grace CPU and Blackwell Ultra GPU, and it can be yours in a pretty standard-looking desktop chassis today.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia officially launched the latest DGX Station desktop at Computex 2026 earlier this year, but the announcement was not accompanied by an explicit price tag. The expectation of an MSRP withers away when it comes to enterprise-grade hardware anyway, but still, early chatter had pointed toward a $100,000 ballpark figure. That number has just been confirmed, as a DGX Station from Exxact was found listed for $94,930 on its website, featuring the all-powerful GB300 Superchip, ready to customize and buy.I repeatedly asked Nvidia at Computex how much the DGX Station desktop tower PC was going to be. The rep kept dodging the question. Welp. It's $100,000 pic.twitter.com/WRxL5Iq7k9August 22, 2026The desktop tower in question is the Valence VWS-158270643 that was originally unveiled a few months ago and was part of the lineup shared by other OEMs such as Dell and HP. Since this hardware is not meant for regular consumers — those who can afford it can pay really any price for it — Nvidia's partners don't make its cost outright public information. Instead, you can ask for quotes or inquire about a proper deployment to get the number. That's why the Exxact listing is newsworthy.The Valence VWS-158270643 starts at $94,930, and that gets you one GB300 enclosed in a standard full-sized tower. The main draw of the GB300 is the Blackwell Ultra GPU that comes with 252GB of HBM3e memory. It talks to a 72-core Arm-based Grace CPU through a 900 GB/s NVLink-C2C interconnect that shares a further 496GB of LPDDR5x RAM with the GPU.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Combined, you get a massive 748GB pool of unified memory that allows you to fine-tune and deploy AI models locally instead of worrying about token costs or any cloud vulnerabilities. For large enterprises that need to quickly iterate on the go and want maximum security, a DGX Station is considered a worthwhile investment even at $100,000, especially if the smaller DGX Spark isn't enough for your workloads. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Exxact) (Image credit: Exxact) (Image credit: Exxact) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original The Valence VWS-158270643 in specific can be configured with different GPUs for video output (since the GB300 doesn't have one) and you get a few SSD options to choose from based on your training data needs. There are three "optimized configs" that go up to $96,316. The top-tier manual configuration costs $108,350 with an RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell (that has its own 96GB of VRAM) and 2x extra 2TB PCIe 5.0 SSDs. Though it comes with Linux-based DGX OS out of the box instead of Windows. Both the Grace CPU and the Blackwell Ultra GPU are liquid-cooled with a massive direct-to-chip (D2C) coldplate, and there are three fans up top for optimal airflow.Front panel I/O is nonexistent, but there are 2x QSFP112 ports at the back driven by the integrated ConnectX-SuperNIC for 800 Gbps/s interconnect between two DGX Station towers. For $100,000, you also get a 3-year warranty so you can rest assured your parts are insured against a potential popping of a bubble. history.descriptionZh:
Nvidia在今年早些时候的Computex 2026上正式发布了最新的DGX Station台式工作站，但当时并未公布具体售价。对于企业级硬件而言，官方建议零售价本就形同虚设，不过业内早前猜测其价格将在10万美元左右。如今这一数字得到证实——系统集成商Exxact网站上已列出该产品，标价为94,930美元，搭载被称为“全能王”的GB300超级芯片，支持定制化配置。

这款型号为Valence VWS-158270643的塔式工作站几个月前已随戴尔、惠普等OEM厂商的产品线一同亮相。由于该硬件并非面向普通消费者，而是针对可承受任意价格的企业客户，Nvidia合作伙伴通常不直接公开成本，需要用户询价或洽谈部署方案，因此Exxact的公开标价颇具新闻价值。

Valence VWS-158270643起价94,930美元，包含一颗GB300超级芯片。其核心亮点是Blackwell Ultra GPU，配备252GB HBM3e高带宽显存，通过900GB/s的NVLink-C2C互联与一颗72核Arm架构Grace CPU通信，两者共享额外496GB LPDDR5x内存。三者合计构成高达748GB的统一内存池，用户可以在本地微调和部署AI模型，无需担忧云端token费用或安全漏洞。对于需要快速迭代并追求极致安全的大型企业，即使10万美元的价格，DGX Station仍被视为值得的投资，尤其是当较小的DGX Spark无法满足工作负载时。

Exxact型号支持配置不同GPU用于视频输出（因GB300本身无显示输出），并提供多种SSD选择以匹配训练数据需求。三种“优化配置”最高售价96,316美元，而顶级手动配置达到108,350美元，包含一块自带96GB VRAM的RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell显卡和两块额外的2TB PCIe 5.0 SSD。

该工作站配备1600W 80+钛金电源，足以覆盖独立显示GPU，可与普通PC一样插入标准插座使用。系统默认运行基于Linux的DGX OS而非Windows。Grace CPU与Blackwell Ultra GPU均采用大规模直接芯片（D2C）冷板液冷散热，顶部配有三个风扇保证气流。机箱前部无I/O接口，后部提供2个QSFP112端口，由集成ConnectX-SuperNIC驱动，支持两台DGX Station之间以800Gbps速率互联；另有1个10GbE RJ45网口、专用1Gbps管理网口、用于本地BMC管理的mini-DisplayPort、USB Micro-B串口、4个标准USB Type-A接口及3.5mm耳机插孔。

Exxact未透露机箱具体材质，但从图片可推断为钢材，设计颇为简洁。10万美元的价格附带3年质保，用户可放心部件安全。单次最多可订购十台，但无标准结算页面，仍需提交联系资料等待回访确认购买。

history.title: Lucky shopper finds RTX 5080 for just $702 at Walmart — saves almost $800 compared to current retail prices
history.description: Walmart’s clearance aisle delivers another remarkable GPU bargain, with a shopper finding a PNY RTX 5080 for nearly half its current retail price.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Shopping for PC parts continues to be a nightmare, with skyrocketing RAM, SSD, and GPU prices paired with unpredictable availability. However, a lucky shopper managed to score a flagship GPU for far less than its original launch price. According to Reddit user u/sparkyscotty55, their local Walmart store was selling a PNY-branded Nvidia RTX 5080 for just $702.56, down from its listed selling price of $1,249. Not only does this deal result in a discount of $546.44, but its final price is also much lower than Nvidia’s suggested $999 retail price for the RTX 5080.A quick price check reveals that this particular PNY RTX 5080 OC graphics card is currently listed at over $1,500 on Amazon, Newegg, and Best Buy. This makes the Walmart clearance price even more impressive, with the shopper essentially paying less than half of what the GPU currently costs at major retailers. The shopper also confirmed that they inspected the box to verify that the GPU inside was indeed the correct model and appeared to be in good condition.Walmart deal how did I do from r/pcmasterraceThe PNY GeForce RTX 5080 OC is a factory-overclocked version of Nvidia's reference RTX 5080 that targets 4K gaming and content-creation workloads. The RTX 5080 packs 10,752 CUDA cores, 16GB of GDDR7 memory on a 256-bit bus, and up to 960 GB/s of memory bandwidth. Its fifth-generation Tensor cores and fourth-generation RT cores enable features such as AI acceleration, hardware-accelerated ray tracing, and Nvidia's DLSS 4 technology, including Multi Frame Generation. The GPU is listed to push the boost clock to 2.73 GHz, up from Nvidia's reference 2.62 GHz, while retaining the 360W power rating. It also uses a substantial cooling system with three 100mm silent fans and a dense heatsink, along with a triple-slot design.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Walmart's clearance aisles have produced rare but similar GPU bargains in the past. For instance, back in February another shopper managed to grab the same RTX 5080 model at just $562.49. During that period, it was one of the few RTX 5080 models sold at Nvidia’s suggested MSRP of $999, thus resulting in an impressive discount of $430 for the lucky customer. Another Walmart clearance find involved an RTX 5060 Ti, with a customer picking up an MSI RTX 5060 Ti Ventus 2X 8GB at just $80. Since the card had launched with an MSRP of $379, the shopper managed to end up saving nearly $300. The deal was particularly interesting as the buyer was reportedly upgrading from a much older GTX 1060, resulting in a massive generational leap at a negligible price.While such deals occasionally result in an incredible bargain, there is always an element of risk, especially when it involves expensive PC hardware. Such items could be customer returns with opened boxes, or items that have been marked down because of damaged packaging or missing accessories. There are also some cases where heavily discounted PC components are returned units that are either damaged, swapped, or do not include the hardware originally sold with it, which makes checking the contents before completing the purchase particularly important. history.titleZh: 幸运购物者在沃尔玛仅花702美元买到RTX 5080，比当前零售价节省近800美元
history.descriptionZh:
近期PC硬件市场价格持续走高，内存、固态硬盘和显卡价格飙升且供货不稳定，令DIY玩家叫苦不迭。然而，一位幸运的购物者却在沃尔玛的清仓货架上淘到了一块旗舰级显卡，价格远低于首发价。据Reddit用户u/sparkyscotty55发帖称，他在当地沃尔玛商店以702.56美元的价格购得一块PNY品牌的Nvidia RTX 5080显卡，而该卡在店内的标价原本为1,249美元。此次折扣高达546.44美元，最终成交价甚至比Nvidia官方建议零售价999美元还低近300美元。

经比价后发现，这款PNY RTX 5080 OC显卡目前在亚马逊、Newegg和百思买上的售价均超过1,500美元，这意味着这位购物者实际支付的价格还不到大型零售商现价的一半。该买家还表示，他当场检查了外包装，确认盒内显卡确为对应型号，且外观状态良好。

这款PNY GeForce RTX 5080 OC是Nvidia RTX 5080参考版的出厂超频型号，定位面向4K游戏和内容创作场景。核心规格方面，它拥有10,752个CUDA核心，配备16GB GDDR7显存，位宽256-bit，显存带宽最高可达960 GB/s。其第五代Tensor Core和第四代RT Core支持AI加速、硬件光追以及Nvidia DLSS 4技术，包括多帧生成（Multi Frame Generation）功能。该卡将加速频率从Nvidia参考版的2.62 GHz提升至2.73 GHz，功耗维持360W不变。散热设计上，该卡采用三槽厚度，配备三把100mm静音风扇和密集型散热鳍片，确保高负载下的温度控制。

类似的沃尔玛清仓显卡低价并非首次出现。今年2月，也曾有另一位买家以仅562.49美元的价格买到同款RTX 5080，当时这款卡在Nvidia建议零售价999美元的基础上已属稀缺，最终相当于额外省下约430美元。另一起案例中，有顾客在沃尔玛以80美元购入一块微星RTX 5060 Ti Ventus 2X 8GB，而这款卡首发建议零售价为379美元，相当于节省近300美元。更特别的是，这位买家据称是从老旧的GTX 1060升级而来，几乎以可忽略的成本实现了跨越数代的大幅性能跃升。

不过，这类清仓特价也伴随着一定风险，尤其是对于高价值PC硬件而言。打折商品可能是被退货的开封产品，也可能因包装破损或附件缺失而降价。更有甚者，部分大幅降价的部件可能是被调包、损坏或不包含原始配件的退货件。因此，在付款前仔细检查包装和内部硬件是否完好、确认型号与附件正确，显得尤为重要。这类稀有交易虽然偶尔能带来惊人性价比，但消费者仍需保持警惕，避免因贪图便宜而踩坑。

history.title: Officials nationwide face death threats and gunfire over AI data center projects — More than 500 towns restrict builds as councils shutter public comment
history.description: Recent data published in the Soufan Center's July IntelBrief found hundreds of posts with threat language between July 2025 and July 2026, and a volume surge beginning in April.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Officials in Marshall, Michigan, did what data center opponents across the country have been demanding: on August 3, its city council passed a one-year moratorium on new builds. Ten days later, police told council members they were the subject of a credible death threat tied to the project. The same week, the 300-person town of Salix, Iowa, postponed its own moratorium vote after Facebook posts put its government "in the crosshairs," and in Box Elder County, Utah, a commissioner who approved a project told KSL he has police stationed outside his house. Then, on August 21, NBC News reported that city leaders nationwide are now receiving death threats over data centers, regardless of which way officials vote.Marshall Mayor Scott Wolfersberger told local news station WWMT that the city's police department contacted him on August 12 about the threat and that the investigation is ongoing. Councilor James Hackworth wrote in a social media post that members had received "a legitimate death threat" and that disagreement, protest, and voting the council out are all part of democracy. It's unclear whether the sender supports or opposes data centers, and no suspect has been identified to date.Meanwhile, Salix Mayor Kevin Nelson has said that the Woodbury County Sheriff's Office is investigating posts that called for "various death and terroristic type things" against the entire city government. Nelson said threats first came in May, after the town annexed 900 acres of farmland in April for a site Google is evaluating.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Woodbury County is separately challenging the annexation in court. The council met a week late on August 20 and voted 3-2 against the moratorium, with Nelson calling officers into the room as members of the public and councilman Gene Monk objected. "We ask for a cool-down period for a year to research, then we can make an educated decision. We can let the people vote for it after that — do something different," Monk said. "It's too big of a decision for us five people [council members]."Over in Box Elder County, Utah, Commissioner Lee Perry has said that he and fellow Commissioners Boyd Bingham and Tyler Vincent had received threats after voting through two resolutions for the Stratos project area, with an audience of roughly 500 chanting "shame" at the meeting. In April, Indianapolis councilman Ron Gibson had 13 rounds fired into his home after backing a rezoning, and Saline Township, Michigan, treasurer Jennifer Zink resigned in May citing threats over the 1.4GW Oracle and OpenAI campus that triggered moratoriums in at least 19 Michigan municipalities. Emporia, Kansas, moved its August 5 and August 19 commission meetings online and dropped public comment after its leaders were threatened.Recent data published in the Soufan Center's July IntelBrief, which is based on a year of scraping X and Reddit, found hundreds of posts with threat language between July 2025 and July 2026, and a volume surge beginning in April that hasn't receded. Most violent threats in its dataset are targeted towards infrastructure rather than people, with posts naming council members and planning commissions a small minority. history.titleZh: Officials nationwide face death threats and gunfire over AI data center projects — More than 500 towns restrict builds as councils shutter public comment
history.descriptionZh:
过去一年间，美国各地围绕AI数据中心建设的冲突持续升级，如今已从激烈的公共辩论演变为针对地方官员的直接人身威胁。密歇根州马歇尔市成为最新案例：8月3日，市议会顺应全国反对者的呼声，通过了一项为期一年的新建项目暂停令；仅十天后，警方告知议员们，他们因该决定收到了可信的死亡威胁。同样在这一周，爱荷华州仅有300人口的Salix镇在Facebook上出现针对整个市政府的“各类死亡和恐怖主义言论”后，被迫推迟了原定的暂停令投票；犹他州Box Elder县一位批准项目的专员透露，已有警察驻扎在他家门外。8月21日，NBC新闻报道称，全美各地的城市领导人如今无论投票倾向如何，都在因数据中心问题收到死亡威胁。

马歇尔市长Scott Wolfersberger向当地媒体证实，警方于8月12日联系了他，调查仍在进行中。市议员James Hackworth在社交媒体上表示，议员们收到了“合法的死亡威胁”，同时强调分歧、抗议和投票罢免官员都属于民主的组成部分。目前尚不清楚威胁发送者是支持还是反对数据中心项目，也无人被捕。Salix市长Kevin Nelson称，伍德伯里县警长办公室正在调查相关帖子——这些威胁最早出现在5月，正值该镇4月吞并900英亩农田以配合谷歌评估选址之后。该县已另行在法庭上对吞并提出异议。Salix议会推迟一周后于8月20日开会，以3比2否决了暂停令；期间市长将警察召入会场，因为公众和一名市议员Gene Monk表示强烈反对。Monk在讨论中说：“我们要求有一年的冷静期来做研究，然后才能做出明智的决定。之后可以让人民投票——换一种做法。这对我们五个人（议员）来说，决定太重大了。”

在犹他州Box Elder县，专员Lee Perry透露，他和同事Boyd Bingham、Tyler Vincent在约500名观众齐声高喊“可耻”的会议上投票通过Stratos项目区的两项决议后，都收到了威胁。这些并非孤立事件，此前已有暴力先例：4月，印第安纳波利斯市议员Ron Gibson在支持一项重新分区后，家中被人射入13发子弹；密歇根州Saline Township财务主管Jennifer Zink在5月因1.4GW的Oracle与OpenAI园区项目遭受威胁而辞职，该项目曾导致至少19个密歇根州城镇出台暂停令。堪萨斯州Emporia市在领导人受威胁后，将8月5日和19日的委员会会议改为线上，并取消了公众评论环节。

Soufan中心7月发布的IntelBrief报告基于对X和Reddit平台为期一年的数据抓取，发现2025年7月至2026年7月间有数百条包含威胁性语言的帖子，且从4月开始数量激增，至今未见回落。数据显示，大多数暴力威胁指向基础设施而非具体个人，点名议员和规划委员会的帖子只占少数。许多帖子使用表情包、表情符号和故意拼写错误来规避平台审核。该中心还发现，每一起新事件现在引发的次级放大效应远高于今年早些时候。Emporia市长表示，针对委员会的威胁似乎并非来自当地居民。目前，Salix、Emporia和马歇尔都已因威胁取消、转移或限制了公共会议——而此时全美已有超过500项针对数据中心的本地限制措施生效。这场由AI算力需求驱动的建设热潮，正在把原本属于土地规划和能源分配的地方决策，推向安全与民主治理层面的严峻考验。
